paper_only: this action works only live, and the agent is in paper mode
per_trade_cap: it is above your per-trade cap
ceiling: it is above the wallet's ceiling, which only your owner key can raise
daily_cap: it would pass your 24-hour cap ({used} of {cap} used)
gas_reserve: it would leave the wallet below its gas reserve
slippage: the requested slippage is above your slippage limit
price_impact: the price impact is above your maximum
tax: the token's tax is above your maximum
venue_off: this agent may not use this venue
token_denied: the token is on your deny list, or missing from your allow list
send_level: your send level does not allow this address
unsaved_address: the address is neither your rescue address nor one you saved; saving one needs your owner key
outside_content_send: it sends to an address outside your address book after reading outside content
health_factor: it would leave the health factor below your minimum
no_price: binference found no USD price for this token
honeypot: the token looks like a honeypot: you might not be able to sell it
cannot_sell: a test sale of the token failed, so you might not be able to sell it
hidden_owner: the token's contract has a hidden owner who can change it
snipe_tax: the token launched seconds ago, and its snipe tax on a buy is above your maximum tax
high_tax: the token takes a high tax on every trade
high_pool_fee: the pool fee on this route is above your maximum tax; the token itself takes no tax on a buy
high_tax_with_pool_fee: the token's tax on a buy and the pool fee on this route together are above your maximum tax
low_liquidity: the token has too little liquidity
sources_down: the risk checks could not reach their data sources
blacklisted: the token's contract can blacklist wallets
no_route: no route was found for this trade
decode_mismatch: the built transaction did not match what you confirmed, so it was not signed
simulation_reverted: the simulation reverted, so nothing was sent
effects_differ: the simulation showed other results than the quote, so nothing was sent
nothing_to_sell: the wallet holds too little of this token
balance_unread: the wallet's balance could not be read; it tries again
needs_launch_wallet: a live trade on a launch's own curve runs only from the agent's launch wallet: make one with `binference wallet create --launch` and fund it, or leave out the wallet you named
launch_unread: binference could not read the launch's curve from its launchpad, so nothing was sent; try again
launch_moved: the launchpad no longer holds the token on the curve its quote named, as after its graduation, so nothing was sent; propose the trade again
reverted: the transaction reverted; only the network fee was spent
stuck_cancelled: the transaction was stuck and was cancelled; only the network fee was spent
nonce_taken: another transaction used this wallet's nonce, so this one did not land
step_unsent: an earlier step landed, but a later one was never signed
stuck_dropped: the transaction was stuck and could not be sent any more, so it did not go through
order_inactive: the order ended, was paused or used its last fill before the trade could run
fill_bounds: the trade would go past the order's size or slippage
worst_price: the price is worse than the order's worst price
trigger_unconfirmed: the trade's own price did not reach the order's trigger price
copy_daily_cap: it would pass this leader's daily cap ({used} of {cap} used)
engine_locked: binference is locked, so nothing fills until you run `binference unlock`
live_fills_off: live auto orders do not fill yet; only paper ones do
nothing_to_spend: the wallet holds too little of what the order spends
fill_failed: the fill failed partway and nothing was traded; it tries again
